questions.korean: 그는 우리 반에서 가장 키가 커.
answers: He is the tallest in our class.
He is the tallest student in our class.

questions.korean: 이게 내가 먹어본 것 중 가장 맛있는 피자야.
answers: This is the most delicious pizza I've ever had.
This is the best pizza I've ever eaten.
questions.hint: the most + 형용사 + I've ever + 과거분사

answers: She works the hardest in the group.
She is the hardest worker in the group.
Mount Everest is the highest mountain in the world.
Everest is the tallest mountain in the world.
questions.explanation: highest = 해발 기준, tallest = 지면으로부터 높이

questions.korean: 그게 내 인생에서 가장 어려운 결정이었어.
answers: It was the hardest decision of my life.
That was the most difficult decision of my life.
There is an apple on the table.
There's an apple on the table.
There are many kids in the park.
There are a lot of children in the park.
questions.explanation: many = a lot of = lots of

answers: There is no milk in the fridge.
There isn't any milk in the fridge.
questions.hint: There is no + 명사 / There isn't any

questions.korean: 그 도시에는 박물관이 몇 개 있어.
answers: There are a few museums in the city.
There are several museums in the city.
questions.explanation: a few = 몇 개, several = 여러 개

answers: There is a cafe at the end of the street.
There's a coffee shop at the end of the street.
questions.hint: at the end of the street = 길 끝에

answers: I always eat breakfast.
I always have breakfast.
She usually goes to bed at 11 p.m.
She usually sleeps at 11 p.m.
We often eat out.
We often go out to eat.
He sometimes wakes up late.
He sometimes gets up late.
I never lie.
I never tell lies.
questions.explanation: never는 그 자체로 부정 의미, don't와 함께 쓰지 않음

answers: She looks tired.
She seems tired.
The music sounds good.
That sounds great.
This flower smells nice.
These flowers smell wonderful.
This cake tastes great.
This cake tastes delicious.
This sofa feels really comfortable.
This couch feels so comfortable.
I want to be a doctor.
I would like to become a doctor.
questions.explanation: would like to = want to의 격식체/공손한 표현

answers: What would you like to drink?
What do you want to drink?
questions.hint: What would you like to + 동사원형?

answers: He wants a new car.
He would like a new car.
I want to sleep now.
I feel like sleeping now.

questions.korean: 우리는 여기서 시간을 좀 더 보내고 싶어.
answers: We want to spend more time here.
We'd like to stay here a little longer.
I like listening to music.
I enjoy listening to music.
He enjoys cooking.
He loves to cook.
She loves traveling alone.
She enjoys traveling by herself.

questions.korean: 우리는 함께 영화 보는 걸 즐겨.
answers: We enjoy watching movies together.
We like watching movies together.
I like jogging in the morning.
I enjoy running in the morning.
I have already finished my homework.
I've already done my homework.
She has been to Paris.
She has visited Paris.
questions.explanation: have been to = ~에 가본 적 있다

questions.korean: 나는 그 영화를 세 번 봤어.
answers: I have watched that movie three times.
I've seen that movie three times.
They haven't arrived yet.
They have not come yet.
We have lived here for ten years.
We've been living here for ten years.
This letter is written in English.
The letter is written in English.
The bridge was built in 1900.
The bridge was constructed in 1900.
The cake was made by my mother.
The cake was baked by my mom.
The store is closed on weekends.
The shop is closed on weekends.
The package will be delivered today.
The parcel will be delivered today.
I want to speak English well.
I want to be good at English.

questions.korean: 그는 새 컴퓨터를 살 필요가 있어.
answers: He needs to buy a new computer.
He has to get a new computer.
We plan to leave early.
We are planning to leave early.
She wants to learn how to cook.
She'd like to learn how to cook.
questions.hint: want to + learn how to + 동사원형

questions.korean: 나는 내일 아침 일찍 일어나야 해.
answers: I need to wake up early tomorrow morning.
I have to get up early tomorrow morning.
questions.hint: need to / have to + wake up

answers: I was tired but I studied.
I was tired but still studied.
It rained, so we stayed home.
It was raining, so we stayed inside.
I was hungry, so I ordered pizza.
I ordered pizza because I was hungry.
He is smart and hardworking.
He is clever and diligent.
I wanted to study, but I was too sleepy.
I wanted to study but I was too tired.
questions.hint: wanted to study + but + too sleepy
